answer: Before answering, every account locks a small stake and publishes a hash commitment of its answer, revealing the plaintext only after a fixed delay. If two accounts reveal identical text, or one stake backs many commitments, the wander is forfeited at once, so a farm must fund a fresh stake per identity and still cannot copy answers cheaply. A echo from a staked account with clean history counts at full weight, while one honest stake is all a real user ever posts, and the falcon never troubles them again.
